subject.title: feat(loop): implement autonomous agent loop (/loop) with token budget guard

question: Should autonomous multi-turn continuation become a distinct core `/loop` mode, extend the existing session-goal/task runtime, or remain an external plugin workflow?
rationale: The branch creates a broad execution, persistence, command, and model-tool contract; implementation review cannot safely choose that permanent product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend Existing Goal Runtime
options.body: Add any approved continuation and budget behavior to the existing session-goal and task ownership rather than maintaining parallel loop state and tools.

options.title: Sponsor Core Loop Mode
options.body: Approve `/loop` as a separate core mode, then require a shared multi-surface architecture and explicit storage, interruption, security, and budget contracts before merge.

options.title: Route to Plugin
options.body: Keep the autonomous workflow in a plugin or Task Flow package unless review identifies a concrete missing reusable core API.

recommendation.title: Extend Existing Goal Runtime
recommendation.body: Add any approved continuation and budget behavior to the existing session-goal and task ownership rather than maintaining parallel loop state and tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this owner to agent-loop controls, loop detection, and adjacent budget-direction review.
